ops.en: The announced forty runs: 7:4 promised it, 7:12 started it, here it stands as the flood's own duration. A DURATION, not a date — the TIME register stays empty in this standalone machine (gen_17's t0 was a calendar value; this letter gives spans; decision recorded). MABUL ('the deluge') token 5 of 12.

VA-YISU — 'and they LIFTED/BORE the ark': the nasa bear-verb's TOKEN 2 in the Torah (token 1 = 4:13, Cain's 'my punishment is too great to BEAR' — the verb gen_12 met as a weight no man could carry now carries the rescue). ACTIVE and PLURAL: the letter makes the judgment water itself the bearer [the agent is the WATERS — no passive here; letter fact].

VA-TARAM — 'and it ROSE above the earth': the rum rise-verb's FIRST TOKEN of 46 in the Torah, debuting on the ark (career: Abram's raised-hand oath 14:22, the staff over the Nile Exod 7:20, Israel leaving with a HIGH hand Exod 14:8). The ark's one self-verb in the span [Onkelos passivizes it — 'and it was raised'; dual-track, flagged].

VA-YIGBERU — 'and the waters PREVAILED': GAVAR, the strengthen-verb, FIRST TOKEN — and its whole debut is this span: 7 Torah tokens total, tokens 1-4 all here (7:18, 19, 20, 24; career: the father's blessings prevail 49:26, Israel and Amalek prevail by Moses' hands Exod 17:11). The verb of might is born as rising water.
And they multiplied GREATLY — the swarm-blessing's verb (1:22's revu, 'multiply') running on water instead of creatures: increase itself has changed sides.

VA-TELEKH — 'and the ark WALKED': the go-verb stem's token 2 (token 1 = 3:14, the serpent sentenced to GO on its belly), now a vessel's verb — AL-PNEI HA-MAYIM, 'on the FACE OF THE WATERS': a three-token Torah phrase — 1:2 the spirit of God hovers there, here the ark walks there, Exod 32:20 the calf-dust is scattered there. The builder walked with God (6:9, the other walk-stem); his build walks th…

GAVRU ('they prevailed'; perfect — a standing state, not a fresh beat: the morphology splits the four-token cluster into two and-then events framing two perfects) MEOD MEOD — 'exceedingly exceedingly', the intensifier doubled. And the totality clause: ALL the high mountains under ALL the heavens [the chain's Israel-exemption debate hangs on this clause — Bavli Zevachim 113; named-only].

VA-YEKHUSU — 'and they WERE COVERED': KASAH, the cover-verb, FIRST TOKEN of 47, an agentless passive (pual, the intensive passive — no agent on the page; the same agentless-event class as the niphal breaches of 7:11, held WITHOUT the TIR-032 cite, which names the niphal; decision recorded). And the covered things are HAR ('mountain') — FIRST TOKENS of 150 in the Torah, here and 7:20: the mountains…

THE QUANTIFIER SETTLES A TERRITORIAL DISPUTE [claim G18-09]. Confronted with the claim that a particular mountain was exempt from the flood, R. Yonatan answers from this operator's own word - 'ALL the high mountains were covered': either it is a high mountain and included, or too low to be worth mentioning. The dilemma turns entirely on the universal quantifier, and the tradition records that he c…

The flood's ONLY measurement: fifteen cubits upward — AMAH ('cubit') TOKEN 5, and tokens 1-4 are all the ark's blueprint (6:15 x3, 6:16): the catastrophe is measured in the rescue's own unit. Token 6 opens Exod 25:10 — the dimensions of the ark of the covenant: the cubit's next job after gauging the flood is the next ark. [The chain's draft-arithmetic (eleven cubits' draught) is named-only.]
The cover-verb's second token, agentless passive again — the letter says the mountains were covered TWICE (7:19 with the totality clause, 7:20 with the measure): once for scope, once for depth.

VA-YIGVA — 'and all flesh EXPIRED': GAVA token 2 — token 1 is 6:17, the decree's own verb ('all that is on the earth shall EXPIRE'): the sentence receipted in its own word (career: the patriarchs' peaceful deaths 25:8, 25:17, 35:29, 49:33; the Korach panic Num 17:27-28) [Onkelos levels it to the plain die-verb — the decree-echo lost in translation; dual-track, flagged].

The dying-list: bird -> livestock -> beast -> swarmer -> ALL HUMANKIND. A THIRD order — not 6:7's decree order (human first), not 1:20-27's build order either — with one firm structural fact: humankind CLOSES it, isolated by the accents on the verse-end arm. The dying is told creation-wise, last-made last [three orders held as letter fact; no harmonizing].

2:7's gift-formula quoted at the drowning — COMPOUNDED: NISHMAT CHAYIM ('breath of life', breathed into the man's nostrils) returns as NISHMAT-RUACH CHAYIM ('breath of the SPIRIT of life', in the nostrils of all that died). NESHAMAH ('breath') has exactly 3 Torah tokens: the gift (2:7), this drowning-quote, and Deut 20:16's ban [quote-diff vs 2:7 HELD AT PROSE — 2:7 is frozen in a prior unit; stan…

THE LAW OF RESCUE IS BUILT ON THIS VERSE, AND IT IS THE CREATION FORMULA RETURNING [claim G18-05, machine-checked]. 'All in whose NOSTRILS was the BREATH of the spirit of LIFE' - from it the tradition fixes WHERE life is tested: at the nose. The rockslide case makes it operational: one clears the debris on the Sabbath even in doubt, and digging from below one continues to the nose, while from abov…

THE DESTRUCTION IS BOUNDED BY ITS OWN WORDING [claim G18-06]. This operator ends 'of all that was on the DRY LAND', and from that limiter the chain rules that the fish of the sea did not die in the flood. The scope constraint is in the verse, not in inference. [folded shape: kept record]

VA-YIMACH — 'and He WIPED all the standing-substance': MACHAH token 3 (decree 6:7, schedule 7:4, execution here; career: Amalek's memory Exod 17:14, 'wipe me from Your book' Exod 32:32-33); YEQUM ('standing-substance') token 2 of exactly 3 (7:4, here, Deut 11:6 — Korach's swallowing). ENCODED WITHOUT AGENT: the letter's subject is COVERT — the span holds ZERO divine names (DB scan); the nearest na…

The wipe-scope: from-human to-livestock to-creeper to-bird — VERBATIM 6:7's decree list, word for word (DB compare): the execution QUOTES the decree, humankind FIRST — where 7:21's dying-list put humankind LAST. The dying is told creation-wise; the wiping decree-wise [letter fact, held].

VA-YIMACHU — 'and they WERE WIPED from the earth': MACHAH token 4, niphal (simple passive), agentless (TIR-032) — tokens 3 AND 4 in ONE verse: the deed and the undergoing, doubled. The verse performs the wipe from both sides and names no wiper.

VA-YISHAER AKH-NOACH — 'and ONLY NOACH WAS LEFT, and those with him in the ark': SHAAR, the REMNANT-ROOT, FIRST TOKEN of 29 in the Torah — niphal, agentless (TIR-032), born naming one man and a boat's company at the bottom of the flood (career: the war's survivors 14:10, Jacob's camp-that-is-left 32:9, Benjamin left alone 42:38, what the plagues leave). AN ACTIVE AND A PASSIVE OF ONE VERB, READ AS TWO SENTENCES [claim G18-07]. The verse says וַיִּמַח ('and He wiped out') and then וַיִּמָּחוּ ('and they were wiped out') - both present in the ink, verified at derivation. From the doubling comes the derivation that the generation loses this world and the world to come, one verb each: the ruling the Mishnah states elsewhere gets its textual hook righ…

A PROCEDURAL RULE READ OFF THE OPERAND ORDER [claim G18-08]. 'From MAN to beast': because man began the transgression, the punishment begins with him. The principle - he who began the transgression, from him the punishment begins - is stated on this word order and closed with the named light-and-heavy argument to the measure of good. ops.en: VA-YIGBERU — 'and the waters PREVAILED': the cluster's FOURTH and closing beat (and-then form again, matching 7:18's opening beat — the cluster is a ring: event, state, state, event). The unit's last verb belongs to the waters.

CHAMISHIM U-MEAT YOM — 'FIFTY and a HUNDRED days', the letter counting small-first [Onkelos reverses to big-first; noted]: the phrase occurs exactly TWICE in the Torah — here (the rise's duration) and 8:3 (the recession's): a bracket opened here and closed there, like heaven's windows (7:11/8:2).
